-- Phase 1: spec only. Bodies are unreachable until phase 2.

-- Pure reference: the list with its first and last elements exchanged.
ends_swapped(xs: List[int]) -> List[int] =
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex ends_swapped([1, 2, 3]) == [3, 2, 1]
  ex ends_swapped([7]) == [7]
  ex ends_swapped([]) == []
  var out: List[int] = []
  let n = xs.len()
  for i in range(0, n)
    var pick = i
    if i == 0
      pick = n - 1
    if i == n - 1
      pick = 0
    out.append(xs[pick])
  out

-- Swaps the first and last elements of xs in place.
-- An empty or one-element list is left unchanged.
swap_ends(var xs: List[int]) =
  pre xs.len() >= 0
  post xs.len() >= 0
  let n = xs.len()
  if n > 1
    let first = xs[0]
    xs[0] = xs[n - 1]
    xs[n - 1] = first
